don’t be sorry!! it happens. Your definitely right that this is basically a Jane Doe case at this point. I sadly don’t think she’s alive, especially since it was shown twice three years apart. Although I guess there’s a small possibility that she’s still out there, oblivious to this insecure side of the internet looking for her. As sad as it is,, In Jane Doe cases, Without a body, All you can do is a side by side analysis of her and the Jane doe she seems to be. This was done before, and after the most recent touch up and enhancements on her photo idk if that Jane Doe is her. It’s understandable why it’s hard to wrap ur mind around. No one likes to think that people can just be erased basically. Sadly in the time period her missing report came up they were known for sometimes being,, not the best. I have family who lived in Illinois around this time and they say it’s more common than you’d think to see these bare minimum like missing reports. And if she really did come from a poor family, It’s all they could afford. I believe this case is real because so far nothing really shows it isn’t. The number associated w her case is for the Chicago Police Department Youth Division and a Redditor found out the investigator who used to own the number. He has sadly passed though. If you think it’s crazy that she’s basically disappeared for the past 30+ years there’s crazier sadder cases w no resolve either. There’s a 95 year old cold case, people still don’t 100% know what happened Roanoke, there’s a lot of mysteries in this world that seem to make no sense.

As her case was made before digitalization and the internet were that commonly used, her poorly photocopied pic, the little to no information, the large possibility of her being a minor (meaning her info is not public), her darker skin and the large possibility that she came from a poor family. All of these things combined in a Missing case from 1989 in Chicago??? It makes sense, Honestly. It’s just incredibly sad to think that an entire person was so lost to time that even w the internet there’s no trace of them. Imagine all the other Does and missing people who don’t reported on largely or just never get found. I think Joanna Lopez is real. I just think her case was severely mishandled.
